description: This file defines utility functions for file system operations such as checking existence of files/directories, creating directories, listing directory contents, writing JSON files, copying files and directories, with support for glob-based exclusions.

methods.name: doesDirExist
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the given path.

methods.name: doesFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: ensureDirExists
methods.description: Creates the directory at the specified path if it does not already exist, with recursive option.

methods.name: emptyExistingDir
methods.description: Removes the directory and all its contents if it exists.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes data as JSON and writes it to a file.

methods.name: copyRecursiveSync
methods.description: Copies a directory and its contents recursively.

methods.name: copyFileOrDir
methods.description: Copies either a file or directory from source to destination, with support for glob pattern exclusions.
